construction: Defined in tools/corpus/make_toy_instances.m and written by MOSEK (mosekopt write, JTASK) from prob.a, c, blc, buc, blx, bux, f, g, accs; read back by mosekopt read, bit-for-bit equal to the written arrays.
derivation: Positive semidefinite cone of order 2 in svec form (lower triangle column by column, off-diagonal scaled by sqrt(2)): F x = (x0, sqrt(2) x1, x2) is svec of X = [x0 x1; x1 x2]. With x1 = 1 fixed, X is PSD iff x0, x2 >= 0 and x0 x2 >= 1; minimising x0 + x2 = trace(X): by the arithmetic-geometric mean inequality x0 + x2 >= 2 sqrt(x0 x2) >= 2, with equality only at x0 = x2 = 1; objective 2.
